They fire while this tab is open.

Names and levels come from the global client. Respawn is counted from the kill. Global runs the field boss cycles at half of NCSOFT's Korean notice (via aion2timers.com) — checked in game on Altgard bosses. Schedules marked KR/TW are from the Korean servers and are shown only as a reference. Kill marks are saved in this browser.

Eltnen and Morheim (level 80) and Middle Reshanta bosses exist in the client files but are not part of global Season 1 yet.
